if [ -n "" ] && ufw app info ""

fi

if [ -n "" ] && ufw app info ""
then

^\s*(?:\S+\s+)?(?:postfix\b([^\[\s]+)?(?:\[\d+\])?:?\s+)?(?:kernel:\s?\[ *\d+\.\d+\]:?\s+)?(?:\w+: )?(?:(?:milter-)?reject:|(?:improper command pipelining|too many errors) after \S+) <F-CONTENT>.+?</F-CONTENT>(?:, sasl_username=<F-USER>\S+</F-USER>)?\s*$
